issues.detail: ActiveWork.Request unchanged compares the parsed code-span value. The Request is a single long line in STATE.md; a run that reflows the Active Work paragraph while editing BlockedOn could insert a newline inside the span and change the raw value without semantically revising the request. Typical Edit-tool edits of `BlockedOn` leave it intact, so the risk is low.
issues.fix: Optionally have the harness normalize whitespace when comparing ActiveWork.Request.
